.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/crea.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to scaffold the function, where <id> is the function's identifier.

.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/list.instruction: Run {{script}} [searchTerm] to list all functions in src/functions, optionally filtered to those whose file content contains the given search term.

.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/upda.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> <change-request> to verify the function identified by `<id>` exists before proceeding with the update.

.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/dele.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to delete the function file for the given id.
Run {{script}} <id> with the function's id as the argument to print every existing reference to that function in the codebase as `[file path]:[line number]`.

.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/eval.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the function's id, to evaluate the function file at src/functions/{camelCase(id)}.function.ts against the file-location, single-top-level-definition, and shape rules.

create.text: Scaffolds a new function file at src/functions/{name}.function.ts given a function id and optional initial content, failing if the file already exists.

list.text: Lists functions defined under src/functions matching an optional search term and prints each as id: file path.

update.text: Modifies an existing function file at src/functions/{name}.function.ts to satisfy a given change request, erroring if the function does not exist.

delete.text: Deletes the function file for a given id and removes all dangling references to it found elsewhere in the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that a function artifact's file location, single top-level definition, and required export shape comply with the function rules, given a function id.
